instruction: I need to emphasize the first paragraph of this course outline. Please make all the text in the first paragraph bold.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires making all text in the first paragraph bold. Evaluator checks if all runs in the first paragraph have bold formatting applied. Similar complexity to original strikethrough task.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly extracts state by opening the DOCX file and identifying the first non-empty paragraph
Metric logic correctly checks all runs in the first paragraph for bold formatting (run.font.bold)
Complete coverage: Evaluator verifies the entire requirement - all text in first paragraph must be bold
Edge cases properly handled: empty documents, no paragraphs, whitespace-only runs, and document loading errors all return 0.0
Postconfig correctly saves the file (Ctrl+S) before evaluation to ensure modifications are persisted
Data flow is correct: postconfig saves → getter fetches file → metric analyzes bold formatting
Expected parameter handling is appropriate: empty rules dict for rule-based check, metric doesn't need to access expected values
